en.title: Mohamed Hamlil
en.description: Mohamed Hamlil, M1 Artificial Intelligence at Universite Grenoble Alpes. Research in bilinear map rank and in algorithmic pricing, plus projects with measured results.

blocks.title: I count what things cost, then try to make them cost less.
blocks.lede: M1 Artificial Intelligence at Université Grenoble Alpes, UFR IM²AG and Ensimag. EFELIA-MIAI excellence scholarship, and French student-entrepreneur status (SNEE). Two research internships, in computer algebra and in industrial economics.

items.title: Rank of bilinear maps
items.desc: How few multiplications a product actually needs. A heuristic that cuts 5×5 polynomial multiplication over GF(2) from 25 to 14.

items.title: AI and strategic pricing
items.desc: Whether algorithms sustain tacit collusion in repeated price competition, and an error found later in my own equilibrium analysis.

items.title: after-hours
items.desc: Reinforcement learning, computer algebra and applied maths, built outside coursework.
